scope.exclusion_reason: Frozen evidence, prior execution logs, captured inputs, caches and generated databases are not the candidate runtime. The executable production, migration, acceptance and test code is included.

platform_limitations.impact: The two one-time captured-input importers are not supported unchanged on Windows. Core collection, replay, validation and export do not import fcntl.

platform_limitations.requirement: macOS Vision framework exposed through /usr/bin/swift plus Poppler pdftoppm
platform_limitations.impact: A full replay that encounters the two reviewed image-only capacity PDFs requires macOS Vision and Swift. Text-layer adapters remain portable across the declared CPython runtimes.

sqlite.minimum_reason: ferclib.staging uses INSERT ... ON CONFLICT ... DO UPDATE (SQLite UPSERT, introduced in 3.24.0).
required_capabilities: WAL journal mode for file-backed staging databases

external_executables.name: CPython interpreter
external_executables.invocation_policy: Entry points use /usr/bin/env python3; child Python processes use sys.executable. Replay normalizes python and python3 steps to sys.executable.
external_executables.host_observation: Both /usr/bin/python3 3.9.6 and /opt/homebrew/bin/python3.14 3.14.7 were available for compatibility tests.

external_executables.name: pdftoppm
external_executables.required_for: image-only capacity extraction and the fail-closed A17 gate in the declared full replay and release acceptance suite
external_executables.limitation: The exact page render is both hash-verified acceptance evidence and the input to local macOS Vision OCR.

external_executables.name: Swift + macOS Vision
external_executables.required_for: pixel-to-text extraction of reviewed image-only capacity PDFs
external_executables.host_observation: /usr/bin/swift and the macOS Vision framework successfully recovered both A17 page populations; tesseract was not installed or used.
external_executables.limitation: OCR output is never accepted by itself. The ordinary capacity selector must recover the subject/value/unit/qualifier/caveat signature and exactly match the independent source-hash-bound manual review; disagreement publishes nothing.

external_executables.name: zip/unzip CLI
external_executables.host_observation: Not tested because archive read/write uses Python zipfile.

external_executables.name: sqlite3 CLI
external_executables.host_observation: /usr/bin/sqlite3 3.43.2 was available, but application commands use Python sqlite3.

permitted_children: the current CPython interpreter for replay, test and packaging subprocesses
pdftoppm inside ferclib/image_ocr.py and tools/verify_reviewed_image_sources.py with shell=False and bounded render arguments
/usr/bin/swift executing only the shipped tools/vision_ocr.swift source against a temporary rendered page, with shell=False and a credential-free environment
subprocess_policy.note: run.py executes run.py steps in-process and rewrites python/python3 to sys.executable. The declared run plan must not name an arbitrary executable.

read access to frozen inputs and source cache
write access and atomic rename within the output filesystem
